### `Assemble`

`assemble` (the `particles.assemble` preset, spec 9 §9.13): particles fly from scattered
positions onto their birth sites along a critically damped spring that settles exactly at
`at + dur`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | `Time` | yes | When the flight starts (layer time, or a marker). Required. |
| `dur` | `Time` \| null | no | Seconds until every particle has settled. Default 1.5. |
| `from` | `ParticleAssembleFrom` \| null | no | Default `scatter`. |
| `distance` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Scatter radius, px. Default 600. |
| `randomness` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Percent of `dur` the particles' starts spread over. Default 40. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`doc.unknown_field`).

### `AssembleScatter`

The keyword `scatter`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"scatter"` | Around each site at up to `distance`. |

### `Aux`

The aux sub-system (spec 9 §9.7): a second system emitted by the main system's particles,
with the particle properties of §9.5 and its own physics.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `emit` | `AuxEmit` \| null | no | Default `continuously`. |
| `rate` | `Animatable_Scalar` \| null | no | Per second per main particle, or per event. Default 30. |
| `startEmit` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Percent of the main particle's life where emission starts. Default 0. |
| `stopEmit` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Percent of the main particle's life where emission stops. Default 100. |
| `life` | `Animatable_Scalar` \| null | no | Seconds, sampled at birth. Default 3. |
| `lifeRandom` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Percent. Default 0. |
| `sprite` | `ParticleSprite` \| null | no | Default `sphere`. |
| `size` | `Animatable_Scalar` \| null | no | Diameter, px, sampled at birth. Default 10. |
| `sizeRandom` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Percent. Default 0. |
| `sizeOverLife` | array of `Vector` \| null | no | Multiplier over life. Default `[[0, 1], [1, 1]]`. |
| `opacity` | `Animatable_Scalar` \| null | no | Percent, sampled at birth. Default 100. |
| `opacityRandom` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Percent. Default 0. |
| `opacityOverLife` | array of `Vector` \| null | no | Multiplier over life. Default `[[0, 1], [0.9, 1], [1, 0]]`. |
| `color` | `Animatable_ColorValue` \| null | no | Sampled at birth. Default `#FFFFFF`. |
| `colorRandom` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Percent, OKLCh hue and lightness. Default 0. |
| `colorOverLife` | `ColorOverLife` \| null | no | Color over life or picked at birth. |
| `palette` | array of `ColorValue` \| null | no | One random color per particle. |
| `rotation` | `Vector` \| null | no | `[x, y, z]` degrees at birth. Default `[0, 0, 0]`. |
| `rotationRandom` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Percent. Default 0. |
| `spin` | `Vector` \| null | no | `[x, y, z]` degrees per second. Default `[0, 0, 0]`. |
| `spinRandom` | `Scalar` \| null | no | Percent. Default 0. |
| `orientToMotion` | boolean \| null | no | Default false. |
| `faceCamera` | boolean \| null | no | Default true. |
| `blend` | `ParticleBlend` \| null | no | Default `normal`. |
| `glow` | `Glow` \| null | no | A soft halo per particle. |

| `velocity` | `Animatable_Scalar` \| null | no | Px/s. Default 0. |
| `spread` | `Animatable_Scalar` \| null | no | Degrees, cone half-angle about the parent's motion. Default 180. |

### `AuxEmit`

When aux particles are emitted (spec 9 §9.7).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"continuously"` | `rate` per second per main particle. |
| `"atBirth"` | `rate` particles when a main particle is born. |
| `"atDeath"` | `rate` particles when a main particle dies. |
| `"atBounce"` | `rate` particles when a main particle collides (needs `physics.bounce`). |

### `BodyShape`

Any of:

- `ShapeKind`
- `ExplicitShape`

### `BodyType`

Body types.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"dynamic"` | Moved by the simulation. |
| `"static"` | Never moves. |
| `"kinematic"` | Follows its keys, pushes others. |
